characters.summary: Darkseid is the tyrannical New God ruler of Apokolips, possessing god-like physical attributes, invulnerability, and the devastating Omega Beams. He relies on raw cosmic dominance, energy projection, and subjugation rather than intricate martial arts.

techniques: Omega Beams (can curve around corners, disintegrate, or cause a target never to have existed)
Teleportation of himself or others through time and space; Boom Tubes

mechanisms: Nigh-immortal New God physiology (but has been killed on several occasions)
Prime Earth: unfazed by the combined assault of the Justice League (Justice League vol. 2 #6)

weaknesses: Radium
The Source
Hubris
Radion: in Final Crisis Batman shot him with the radion bullet that had killed Orion

limitations: Omega Beams can occasionally be dodged or deflected by extreme force or speed.
Prefers to use his intelligence to manipulate or control others rather than fight personally
